metrics.profile_summary: Experienced performance marketing and ecommerce leader specializing in driving online sales and conversion optimization. Proven track record in managing paid media budgets and technical ecommerce operations across multiple platforms.

experience.description: Managed online sales strategies, conversion rates, and paid media budgets across Facebook and Google Ads to optimize ROI and CPL/CPA.
Developed ecommerce strategies, optimized digital channels, and executed online marketing campaigns for various clients.
Executed comprehensive performance campaigns across Google, Facebook, Snapchat, and TikTok; managed budgets and reported ROI to stakeholders.
Provided digital transformation guidance and optimized website performance and marketing campaigns.
Led technical ecommerce operations, migrated site to Shopify, and supervised customer support, warehouse, and digital marketing teams.
Managed Shopify store operations, monitored GA/GSC trends, and oversaw social media platforms and order fulfillment.
Provided software support and technical analysis.

strengths: Expertise in GA4 and multiple ad platforms (Google, FB, TikTok, Snapchat)
Strong leadership experience as 'Head of Ecommerce'
Deep technical knowledge of Shopify and ecommerce conversion optimization
weaknesses: Degree is in Computer Science rather than Marketing/Business
Less emphasis on high-level brand strategy and creative direction compared to performance metrics
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly technical performance marketer who exceeds the requirements for GA4 and ad platform reporting. While lacking a formal marketing degree, his experience leading ecommerce functions and managing teams makes him a strong candidate for the Marketing Manager role.
